setup_steps: Open a private or offline custom game.
Select Highrise and disable bots if the current menu permits it.
Use the same spawn side, window size, graphics settings, controller, and initial view in every take.
Queue the take, return focus to the game, and perform the route naturally without recorder commands.
post_take_policy: Confirm or correct route boundaries and derive visual reference observations only after gameplay.
completion_evidence: The same chosen finish cover is centered in view.
claims_boundary: Representative FPS plumbing and route-alignment POC; no combat validation.
